messages:
Maya: Quick sync — proposing a two-stage intake: a lightweight 'bakeoff' smoke funnel (fast checks + golden prompts) and a deeper bench for a sampled subset. Need quick alignment on sampling strategy, fallback ordering, and per-model caps. TL;DR: tiered sampler + fast-fail policy so we don't blow up bench or user latency.
Samir: can you paste the config you have in mind?
Maya: sure, rough sketch:```yaml
smoke_funnel:
  sample_rate: 0.25  # run basic smoke checks on 25%
  golden_set_size: 50
deep_bench:
  initial_sample: 0.05  # 5% of traffic -> deep bench
  adaptive_on_variance: true
fallback_order: ["quantized_variant", "shorter_ctx", "fallback-micro-model"]
caps:
  per_model_per_minute: 200
  bench_token_budget_per_minute: 500000
```
Eli: what are the exact gate metrics? p95 latency, token cost, and a quality delta to golden?
Maya: yes — primary gates: p95 latency (hard SLO), token cost delta, and quality regression vs golden prompts (we can compute rouge-like or model-specific metric). if quality drops >2% on golden set -> trigger fallback.
Rachel: +1. also consider a jittered sampling window to avoid correlated spikes across models. :thinking:
Jonathan: my worry: if adaptive sampling bumps deep_bench during a high-traffic period we could saturate bench workers and cause queueing. Need emergency backoff.
Maya: agreed — emergency circuit: if bench queue length > N or bench latency > X -> auto-downgrade sample_rate and move to cheaper fallback. We'll also cap per-model deep_bench concurrency.
intake-bot: [automated] note: current bench cluster capacity = 120 workers, avg utilization 62%.
Samir: suggestion: start small with a meta-controller that watches variance and bench headroom. e.g., begin at 2% deep bench, bump to 10% only if quality variance > threshold AND bench_util < 70%.
Eli: I'll add support in intake for these fields: "bakeoff_caps", "adaptive_sampling_threshold", and an opt-in "fast_fail_policy" flag.
Rachel: can we gate the golden set selection? prefer stratified by seqlen and prompt-type so small models don't get unfairly penalized. :thumbsup: 
Maya: good call. will add stratification by seqlen / domain buckets. also adding a shortplaybook: if model hits repeated regressions, mark as "stale" and route to human review + rollback.
Jonathan: operational note: add a hard kill if total bench_token_budget_per_minute exceeded to prevent billing shock.
Maya: ok let's capture this as follow-up RFC. action items: Samir -> meta-controller proto, Eli -> intake config patch, Rachel -> golden-set stratifier recipe, Jonathan -> safety caps + kill switch. I'll draft RFC and ping @infra and @ops for capacity signoff. thanks all.
